verdict.rationale: The evidence shows no registry or ecosystem of reusable packages for common hardware drivers or robot behaviors. The FormantIO toolkit offers UI elements and custom view modules for building apps, which are developer building blocks for dashboards rather than hardware or behavior packages. Adapter auto-restart and device configuration templates are adjacent features, not a pullable package ecosystem.

support.subject: As a developer, I can pull reusable packages or modules from a registry or ecosystem for common hardware and behaviors
